jobs.occupation: Finance Transformation Manager (f/m/d) (Controller/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Location: Erlangen, Nürnberg, Mühlheim, Hamburg, Berlin, Lisbon, Bucharest, WarsawDepartment: SE FIN TI BCJob Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-KreisMode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / PermanentA Snapshot of Your Day For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Subject to the future setup and related decisions, the role may offer a path toward taking on team leadership responsibility for this unit.How You’ll Make an Impact * Support the carve-out of Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership roleWhat You Bring* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantageAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. jobs.occupation: Head of Function Controlling (f/m/d) (Controller/in)

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day This position is newly created, and that is the whole point of it. Transformation of Industry does not yet have a dedicated Function Controlling — you are the person who builds it, for a functional cost base estimated at more than €600 million. You define the operating model, the cost center and manpower steering logic, the reporting cadence and the standards that the functions will be steered by, and you build the team that runs them.You are not starting from an empty page. A part of the team will transfer into the new unit, so you begin with experienced colleagues who know the business, the processes and you grow the team around them. Siemens Energy's corporate Function Controlling team supports you closely on top of that, so you can build on proven methods and standards rather than invent everything yourself.The timing makes the task unusually rewarding. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. A standalone company needs its own function cost transparency from day one — and few finance leaders get the chance to shape a controlling discipline that does not exist yet, with experienced colleagues behind them, for a company that is coming into existence around them.Your second role is that of Finance Business Partner to the corporate functions — IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement and Finance among them. You are the financial counterpart their leaders turn to, and just as importantly you develop your own people into that role: a function controller who only reports numbers is not yet a business partner, and getting the team there is one of your central tasks.You are joining the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry at a moment when it is preparing to evolve towards a Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, potentially bringing together more than 100 finance professionals. The future setup is still being explored, and the people who join now can contribute to shaping it. In this position, you report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside your peers in the FP&A management team. How You’ll Make an Impact * Build the Function Controlling discipline for Transformation of Industry from the ground up, including the operating model, scope, governance, interfaces, and organizational structures, with the support of Siemens Energy's corporate Function Controlling team* Lead the financial performance management of functional cost centers across monthly closings, forecasts, and budgets* Act as Finance Business Partner to IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement, and Finance by analyzing cost and manpower drivers and translating them into actionable business insights* Establish standalone function cost transparency, including separation effects, the target cost base, and the steering logic replacing group allocations* Design standardized and automated controlling processes and dashboards that provide real-time visibility into function costs and manpower utilization, leveraging AI where it adds valueWhat You Bring* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.* Extensive experience in Financial Controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex international environment.* Proven leadership in building, coaching, and developing finance teams, ideally including the setup or transformation of a finance function and the development of business partnering capabilities.* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and support business decision-making.* Excellent knowledge of SAP, financial reporting, internal controls, and process optimization, combined with a structured hands-on approach in ambiguous environments.* Fluent in English, German is an advantage  About the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.
